_doc: Tags group traits, tools and supplies into families. Tools with a modifier that has "per_tag" get stronger for every matching tag you have: on your tools, on the supplies in your cupboard and on your analysts' traits. color is used for trait pills and tag chips.

name: Caffeine
desc: Coffee, energy drinks, and the people who run on them.

name: Wellbeing
desc: Looking after the team: rest, health, and comfort.

name: Teamwork
desc: Mentoring, sharing, and helping each other out.

name: Science
desc: Seismology, volcanology, tsunami, and landslide know-how.

name: CIMS
desc: Coordinated Incident Management System: response & SOPs.

name: Funding
desc: Finance, budgets, and anything that brings money in.
